title: POPANE-P2 Study 5 independent signal-validity + level-forecast validation
classification: Dependency-resolution analysis under MANUSCRIPT-GATE-01 CLASS C.
selection_rationale: Study 5 was selected before inspecting its values as the largest other published continuous-valence POPANE study, with distinct participants/task/recording study and positive/negative/neutral film segments. It is not a retune of Study 6.

extraction.reuse: Use the frozen POPANE-R1 windowing and feature-extraction implementation where channels exist.
extraction.included_segments: All named nonbaseline segments appearing in >=20 participants, based on filenames only.
extraction.anchors: 10 s spacing, common anchors that support all 1/11/21/31 s target-start gaps.
extraction.target_windows: 5 s means beginning at anchor + 0/10/20/30 s
extraction.feature_families: R1 ECG, EDA and hemodynamic features. ICG features are unavailable in Study 5 and are omitted. Any feature column with zero finite observations is dropped solely as technical unavailability.

evaluation.subject_folds: 10 deterministic folds from sorted participant IDs, round-robin.
evaluation.primary_joint: For each held subject fold × held segment, training excludes all held-fold participants AND all rows of the held segment; segment identity omitted.

learners.ridge: R1 Ridge grid [0.1,1,10,100,1000] with training-only GroupKFold by participant.

signal_validity.target: recent affect mean in [-5,-1] s; deliberately concurrent/aligned positive-control target, not prospective evidence.
signal_validity.shifted: same physiology features after deterministic circular shift by floor(n/2), minimum 2 anchors, within each subject×segment group with >=4 rows; target/time unchanged.

quantities.context_increment: MAE(time-only)-MAE(aligned), positive means aligned physiology adds valence information over time.

signal_validity.valid_rule: Both Ridge and HGB alignment 95% CIs strictly above zero AND at least one learner context_increment 95% CI strictly above zero.

prospective_level.naive: future target = recent affect mean; no fitting.

quantities.naive_increment: MAE(naive)-MAE(physiology), positive means physiology beats recent-state persistence.
quantities.fitted_increment: MAE(fitted_context)-MAE(physiology), positive means physiology adds beyond learned recent-state/context.

decisions.VALID_SIGNAL_WITH_STRONG_BASELINE_DOMINA: Signal-validity rule passes; no horizon has naive_increment CI strictly above zero for either learner; and naive MAE < physiology MAE for both learners at all four horizons.
decisions.VALID_SIGNAL_WITH_PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT: Signal-validity rule passes and at least one horizon has BOTH learners naive_increment CI strictly above zero.
decisions.VALID_SIGNAL_MIXED_FORECAST: Signal-validity passes but level forecast is neither of the above.
decisions.NO_SIGNAL_VALIDATION: Neither learner has a strictly positive alignment CI.

interpretation_gate: Only VALID_SIGNAL_WITH_STRONG_BASELINE_DOMINANCE resolves the specific external 'real aligned signal yet no incremental level utility' dependency cleanly.
VALID_SIGNAL_WITH_PHYSIOLOGY_INCREMENT makes the external forecast story mixed and requires manuscript narrowing.
NO_SIGNAL_VALIDATION means do not add further same-POPANE fishing; seek a genuinely different dataset/access route or accept CLASS C.
Study 5 is not used to reclassify the already frozen Study 6 R1 result.
firewalls: Study 5 partner/couple dependence may not be fully recoverable from filenames; participant-cluster inference must be described with this limitation.
